newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland's NFI funds start continuous trade July 1.
newsitem.headline: Poland's NFI funds start continuous trade July 1.

text.p: Shares in Poland's 15 National Investment Funds (NFIs) will start continuous trade on the Warsaw bourse on July 1, the bourse's president said on Friday.
"The (bourse) management has decided that on July 1 all shares in 15 National Investment Funds will begin continuous trading," Wieslaw Rozlucki told a news briefing.
The fund shares began trading under the main single price auction system on June 12.
Currently shares in 23 listed companies are traded both in the single-price auction system and in the continuous trading session held immediately thereafter.
Rozlucki said the bourse would publish updates for the fund NIF index at five-minute intervals during the continuous session as is the case with the blue-chip WIG20 index.
